# `passportsim usb`

Plug or unplug the USB cable, or open or close the host console.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `power` |
| MCP tool | `passport_usb` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/usb` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `advances_time`, `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim usb [state] [--cable <CABLE>] [--client <CLIENT>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--then-run <THEN_RUN>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cable` | `--cable <CABLE>` | `"in"` \| `"out"` | no | Plug or unplug the cable. |
| `client` | `--client <CLIENT>` | `"open"` \| `"closed"` | no | Open or close the host console. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `state` | `<state>` | `"unplugged"` \| `"charger"` \| `"host"` \| `"open"` | no | Whole USB host state. |
| `then_run` | `--then-run <THEN_RUN>` | `union` | no | Run after a cable or client edge. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/usb.input.json`](../schema/commands/usb.input.json).

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/usb.output.json`](../schema/commands/usb.output.json).

## Examples

### Unplug the cable (U0)

```sh
passportsim usb --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "state": "unplugged"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "state": "unplugged"
}
'@ | passportsim usb --json -
```

### Plug back in with a host console open (U3)

```sh
passportsim usb --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "state": "open"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "state": "open"
}
'@ | passportsim usb --json -
```

### Close the host console and leave the cable in (U2)

```sh
passportsim usb --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "client": "closed"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "client": "closed"
}
'@ | passportsim usb --json -
```
